We hope that you are enjoying your meal with us, and have a lifetime experience in Phuket. Bollywood Indian Cuisine Bollywood Indian Cuisine became a favorite culinary destination across our iconic branches in With a proud 15-year legacy in the Bali hospitality industry, we are now thrilled to bring our signature dedication, expertise, and rich culinary heritage straight to Thailand. A Culinary Melting Pot: We offer a unique, flavorful selection of regional Indian dishes, blending traditional recipes with a conte mporary flair. Theatrical Cooking: Crafted in traditional Tandoor clay ovens and charcoal grills, our food delivers the perfect balance of smokiness, complexity, and bold spices. True Authenticity: Our experienced Chefs supervise every single step to guarantee an unforgettable explosion of taste on your palate. Born in Bali From the Island of the Gods to Phuket Old Town
